recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective photograph of a man leaning toward the camera in a rural setting, featuring a large alligator in the foreground and heavy, stylized 70s-revival typography across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's pointing hand creates a bridge between the background and the viewer.
The alligator in the foreground anchors the bottom horizontal plane.
The large, textured typography sits in front of the subject but behind his reaching hand.
The weathered yellow building provides a geometric backdrop to the organic forms.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Heavy black outlines on all primary text elements
A mix of rural grit and polished pop-rock styling

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man is positioned in the upper right quadrant, leaning forward to occupy the center-top; the alligator occupies the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large alligator at the bottom and the oversized 'U' of the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the man's face down his arm to the pointing finger, then circling through the large central text to the alligator at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky in the upper left provides the only significant breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue and yellow (sky and building) providing a bright, high-key background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark green/brown (alligator and clothing) providing weight at the bottom.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (circular text) and silver-grey (main title fill).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the background with high contrast in the foreground elements to create depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, rounded sans-serif with 70s psychedelic influences.
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that curve outward
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'U' features a large, curling left-side flourish
The 'K' has a curved leg that mirrors the 'U' flourish
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured display face paired with a clean, circular-path sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: The stippled texture inside the letters

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, retro-rock aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of a man in a light blue button-down shirt leaning toward the camera, pointing his finger. In the foreground, a large alligator lies on the grass. The background features a weathered yellow wooden building under a bright blue sky with wispy clouds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, custom-lettered text in the center with a silver stippled fill and thick black outlines. The text should be staggered on two lines. Add a secondary ring of red text circling the man's pointing finger.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective low-angle and wide?
Does the main text have a thick black outline and stippled texture?
Is the alligator clearly visible in the foreground?
Is there a circular text element around the pointing hand?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the man
Any existing brand logos or advisory stickers

mustAchieve: Clear depth between foreground animal and background subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the man's face.
Check that the black outlines on the text are consistent and bold.
Verify the wide-angle distortion is present in the man's reaching arm.
Confirm the silver texture in the text looks like grain or stippling.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a wide-angle rural portrait with an exotic animal foreground and 70s-revival heavy-outline typography for a Y2K southern-rock aesthetic.
